simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַלּוֹתִי (H4413) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַלּוֹתִי (Mallôwthîy) means Mallothi , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 25 4.

definitions.full: H4413. Mallothi מַלּ֫וֺתי as proper name, masculine a son of Heman ( I have uttered = מִלַּלְתִּי Ew § 274 b. N. see מלל ); — 1Chr 25:4 (on this apparently list of names see Ew l.c. RS OTJC 422; 2nd ed. 143 ) 25:26 .
definitions.rootNote: apparently from 4448 ; I have talked (i.e. loquacious)
